source: Dummy corpus moderation and publication policy seed mirrored from manual-work-queue.md. Review-only; no user case log publishes automatically.
notes: Metadata-only: no submitted case logs, account IDs, emails, photos, private notes, raw measurements, moderation tokens, or reviewer identities.
Every rule remains review-gated until Dawson approves publication/exclusion policy or removes public corpus launch from scope.

publicationModes.label: Private review-only queue
publicationModes.reviewStatus: current prototype default; needs review before public launch
notes: Submitted case logs stay in the moderation queue and are not added to the public strategy corpus.
Reviewer endpoints can approve, reject, or remove queue rows, but approval does not publish automatically.

publicationModes.label: Web full corpus
publicationModes.reviewStatus: needs Dawson source and legal review
notes: Candidate mode for a source-reviewed web corpus with age/high-risk gating.
Requires final high-risk exclusion decisions before any public release.

publicationModes.label: iOS trimmed corpus
notes: Candidate mode for native builds if store policy requires a reduced corpus.
May remove surgical, pharmaceutical, or explicit medical-adjacent entries from native distribution.

rules.label: Source-reviewed before publication
decisionsRequired: Approved source-link and citation policy
Minimum evidence labels for public entries
Required uncertainty and limitation wording
Rule for hiding imported or unsupported entries from public browsing
exclusionTriggers: Missing source URL for non-anecdotal claims
allowedCurrentScaffold: Strategy explorer age gate and high-risk acknowledgment
No automatic publication from imported or submitted content

rules.label: High-risk personalization exclusion
decisionsRequired: Which surgical, pharmaceutical, and clinical categories stay web-only
Which categories are removed from all public corpora
Required professional-review wording for high-risk entries
Whether native apps ship a trimmed corpus
exclusionTriggers: Surgical or pharmaceutical action framed as personalized advice
High-risk category without explicit non-personalization status

rules.label: Case-log publication review
decisionsRequired: Reviewer roles and audit trail policy
Redaction and removal policy
Minimum limitation text for n=1 reports
Appeal or takedown process
Decision on whether approved queue rows can ever become public corpus entries
exclusionTriggers: Account IDs, emails, tokens, private notes, photos, or raw measurement fields
Medical advice, diagnosis, dosing, or prescriptive instructions
allowedCurrentScaffold: Approval updates queue status only and does not publish

rules.label: App Store corpus scope
rules.reviewStatus: needs App Store / Play policy review
decisionsRequired: Whether the full corpus is web-only
Native age rating and store-disclosure wording
Which high-risk entries are removed from native builds
Fallback UX for entries excluded from native scope
exclusionTriggers: Explicit medical dosing or clinical instruction
Legal copy not approved for native release
allowedCurrentScaffold: No generated native project release artifacts

rules.label: Tone and claim boundary
decisionsRequired: Approved non-prescriptive wording for public corpus entries
Claim language that separates observation from recommendation
How user-submitted reports label uncertainty and confounders
exclusionTriggers: Instructions to bypass professional or legal review
Case-log text framed as generalized evidence
allowedCurrentScaffold: Strategy detail copy states informational-only boundaries
